notes: Part One 19 assigns VFD furnishing to mechanical and installation to electrical, unless unit-mounted/manufacturer-supplied or specifically noted otherwise.
Loose motor starters, combination starters, disconnects, motor-rated switches and toggle switches are furnished and installed by electrical unless noted otherwise.
Control and interlocking wiring is furnished and installed by the controls contractor.

Automatic temperature controls, including relays, wiring and conduit regardless of voltage, are assigned to mechanical. The ATC section also assigns conduit, wire, junction boxes, thermostat back boxes and circuit breakers necessary for the operating ATC system to mechanical.

Duct smoke detectors that are part of the design-build fire alarm system are furnished and wired by the fire alarm contractor and installed by mechanical. Standalone duct detectors are furnished, installed and wired by mechanical, normally at 24 VAC.

VAV specification includes space temperature sensor, control wiring and transformer. If electric heat is scheduled, it is factory installed with airflow switch, thermal primary cutout, manual reset, disconnect switch and magnetic contactor.
All equipment must have a rating exceeding available fault current at its connection.
Coordination drawings are led by mechanical and must include electrical, low voltage and BAS; each trade supplies AutoCAD documents for the common file before installation.
Owner contract language and architectural Division 1 requirements may supplement or supersede these drawing specifications.
Substitutions require pre-bid consideration and written owner-representative preapproval; bidding notes require requests at least five business days before bid closing.
Electronic shop drawings, CAD/PDF as-builts, PDF O&M information, testing and owner demonstration are required for the specified systems.
General warranty is a minimum one year from owner acceptance; refrigeration compressors have a five-year minimum.
These are general mechanical specifications, not a schedule establishing that VFDs, pumps or electric-reheat VAVs are actually required on this project.

scope.quote: DEMOLITION WILL INCLUDE REMOVAL OF ALL BRANCH CIRCUIT/FEEDER CONDUIT AND WIRING FROM LIGHT FIXTURES/EQUIPMENT TO SOURCE.
scope.statement: Remove indicated power outlets and equipment, including boxes, conduit and wiring back to source; return removed equipment to owner as directed.

scope.quote: THE CONTRACTOR IS RESPONSIBLE FOR MAINTAINING CONTINUITY OF ALL EXISTING POWER AND LOW VOLTAGE CIRCUITING SCHEDULED TO REMAIN, WHICH MAY PASS THROUGH DEMOLITION AREA.
scope.statement: Maintain all existing power and low-voltage circuits scheduled to remain, even when they pass through demolition.

scope.quote: COORDINATE WITH GENERAL CONTRACTOR FOR PHASING OF DEMOLITION WORK AND HOURS THAT WORK CAN BE PERFORMED.
scope.statement: Coordinate demolition phasing and working hours with the general contractor.

scope.quote: EXISTING ROLL UP DOOR AND ALL ASSOCIATED ELECTRICAL CONNECTIONS TO REMAIN.
scope.statement: Retain the roll-up door electrical connections, indicated existing electrical areas, existing fire/smoke dampers and existing VAV units.

scope.quote: MAINTAIN AND CAP OFF EXISTING CONDUIT AND CONDUCTORS FOR USE IN NEW CONSTRUCTION.
scope.statement: Remove lighting and switches, return indicated equipment to owner, and resolve whether existing lighting raceways/conductors are retained or removed.

scope.quote: EXTEND AND CONNECT CIRCUITING FROM JUNCTION BOX TO OUTLETS IN AREA WITH SAME CIRCUIT NUMBERS, ROUTE #12 CONDUCTORS (MINIMUM) THROUGHOUT, UON.
scope.statement: Extend existing junction-box circuits to new receptacles bearing matching circuit numbers, using minimum #12 conductors unless noted otherwise.

scope.quote: PROVIDE ELECTRICAL CONNECTION TO VAV. INTERCEPT, EXTEND, AND CONNECT EXISTING CIRCUIT SERVING VAV PRIOR TO DEMOLITION TO NEW VAV AS INDICATED.
scope.statement: Reconnect six new fire/smoke dampers and VV-2-N to intercepted and extended existing circuits. Electrical ratings and control interfaces are not given on this page.

scope.quote: THE ELECTRICAL CONTRACTOR SHALL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR ALL CUTTING, PATCHING AND PAINTING ASSOCIATED WITH THE ELECTRICAL WORK.
scope.statement: Electrical contractor carries electrical-related cutting, patching, painting and acoustical sealing of back boxes; GC carries the stated penetration firestopping.

scope.quote: ELECTRICAL CONTRACTOR TO LABEL ALL OUTLETS WITH PANEL AND CIRCUIT NUMBER.
scope.statement: Provide healthcare wiring methods, grounding, device grades and outlet circuit identification; coordinate faceplate colors and device heights.

scope.quote: INTERCEPT, EXTEND, AND RECONNECT EXISTING LIFE SAFETY BRANCH CIRCUIT SERVING LIGHTING PRIOR TO DEMOLITION TO NEW LIGHTING FIXTURE AS INDICATED.
scope.statement: Provide lighting, occupancy sensing, dimmer overrides, lockable dimmer cover and extensions of existing lighting circuits, including indicated life-safety connections.

scope.quote: MAINTAIN A MINIMUM WORKING CLEARANCE OF 3’-6” IN FRONT OF ALL ELECTRICAL EQUIPMENT REQUIRING MAINTENANCE, INSPECTION, AND TESTING
scope.statement: Mechanical work must preserve electrical working/dedicated space and coordinate roof-deck hanger loads with electrical installations.

scope.quote: OBTAIN PERMISSION FROM OWNER BEFORE SHUTTING DOWN ANY SYSTEM FOR ANY REASON.
scope.statement: Maintain existing mechanical services during construction through temporary connections; obtain owner permission before shutdowns and coordinate electrical work needed for changeovers.

scope.quote: VFDS TO BE SUPPLIED BY THE MECHANICAL CONTRACTOR AND INSTALLED BY THE ELECTRICAL CONTRACTOR.
scope.statement: Mechanical contractor furnishes non-unit-mounted VFDs; electrical installs them. VFD-to-motor wiring must be shielded power cable designed for VFD use and grounded at both ends.

scope.quote: UNLESS NOTED OTHERWISE, LOOSE MOTOR STARTERS, COMBINATION STARTERS, DISCONNECT SWITCHES, MOTOR RATED SWITCHES, TOGGLE SWITCHES, ETC. TO BE SUPPLIED AND INSTALLED BY THE ELECTRICAL CONTRACTOR.
scope.statement: Electrical furnishes and installs loose motor starters, combination starters, disconnect switches, motor-rated switches and toggle switches unless specifically indicated otherwise.

scope.quote: TEMPERATURE SENSORS, CONTROLLERS, TRANSFORMERS, EQUIPMENT INTERFACE DEVICES AND ALL REQUIRED RELAYS, WIRING AND CONDUIT - REGARDLESS OF VOLTAGE.
scope.statement: Controls contractor carries control/interlocking wiring. Mechanical carries the complete ATC system including wiring and conduit regardless of voltage, required breakers and boxes; clarify 120V power-source locations during bid.

scope.quote: SHALL BE FURNISHED BY THE FIRE ALARM CONTRACTOR, INSTALLED BY THE MECHANICAL CONTRACTOR AND WIRED BY THE FIRE ALARM CONTRACTOR
scope.statement: Fire-alarm-system duct detectors are furnished/wired by fire alarm and installed by mechanical. Standalone duct detectors are furnished, installed and wired by mechanical, normally 24 VAC; detectors shut down associated air-moving equipment on alarm.

scope.quote: DETECTORS TO BE MOUNTED IN THE SUPPLY AIR DUCTWORK.
scope.statement: Duct smoke detection applies to air-moving equipment exceeding 2,000 CFM and equipment below 2,000 CFM serving a common space with aggregate capacity exceeding 2,000 CFM. Detectors mount in supply ductwork.

scope.quote: IF SCHEDULED, THE ELECTRIC HEATING COIL SHALL BE FACTORY INSTALLED WITH AIRFLOW SWITCH, THERMAL PRIMARY CUTOUT, MANUAL RESET, DISCONNECT SWITCH, AND MAGNETIC CONTACTOR.
scope.statement: VAV units include temperature sensor, control wiring and transformer. Electric heat, only if scheduled, includes factory disconnect and magnetic contactor, so do not automatically add duplicate field devices.

scope.quote: EACH TRADE INVOLVED IS TO PROVIDE THEIR DOCUMENTS, IN AUTOCAD FORMAT, TO THE MECHANICAL CONTRACTOR FOR INSERTION TO THE COMMON FILE.
scope.statement: Electrical and low-voltage trades must participate in mechanical-led all-trades coordination drawings and furnish AutoCAD documents for the common file before installation.

scope.quote: PROVIDE A CONDENSATE PUMP WHERE REQUIRED (IE: LITTLE GIANT NXTGEN)

summary: These pages contain the pharmacy power and lighting demolition plans, new power and lighting plans, and the mechanical cover sheet and drawing specifications. Electrical work includes receptacle replacement, extensions of existing circuits, new lighting and controls, and connections to fire/smoke dampers and a VAV unit. Existing power and low-voltage services passing through the work area must remain operational. Mechanical specifications assign loose motor starters and disconnects to electrical, VFD furnishing to mechanical with installation by electrical, and automatic temperature-control wiring to mechanical. No panel schedules, fixture schedules, feeder schedules, or one-line diagrams are included in this group. Some demolition fixture configurations and device classifications require confirmation against the electrical legend and enlarged images; these limitations are identified below.
